lines.text: On the twenty-first day of the seventh month, the LORD spoke through Haggai to Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest.
God asks who is left that saw the house in its former glory, and says it now looks like nothing.
God tells them to be strong and work, since He is with them, as promised when they crossed the Jordan.
God will shake the heavens, earth, sea and dry land, and the nations will come with their armies.
God says this house's latter glory will be greater than the former, and He will provide peace there.
